proof_body:
by
  intro R _ _ _ t hm I
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, t ^ n = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsArtinianRing.isNilpotent_jacobson_bot (R := R)
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    have ht : t ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := hm ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self t
    have hj : t ∈ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal R) := by
      rw [IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal ⊥ bot_ne_top]; exact ht
    have := Ideal.pow_mem_pow hj n
    rw [hn] at this
    exact Ideal.mem_bot.1 this
  have hform : ∀ i : ℕ, ∀ x : R, x ∈ Ideal.span {t ^ (n - i)} → x = 0 ∨ ∃ (u : R) (a : ℕ), IsUnit u ∧ x = u * t ^ a := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero =>
      intro x hx
      left
      simpa [hn] using hx
    | succ i ih =>
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hx
      by_cases hy : IsUnit y
      · exact Or.inr ⟨y, _, hy, rfl⟩
      · have hym : y ∈ Ideal.span {t} := hm ▸ (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal y).2 hy
        obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hym
        by_cases hi : i < n
        · apply ih
          refine Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.2 ⟨z, ?_⟩
          have : n - i = (n - (i + 1)) + 1 := by omega
          rw [this, pow_succ]; ring
        · have : n - i = 0 := by omega
          apply ih
          simp [this]
  by_cases hI : I = ⊥
  · exact hI ▸ ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩⟩
  have hex : ∃ k, t ^ k ∈ I := ⟨n, by rw [hn]; exact I.zero_mem⟩
  refine ⟨⟨t ^ Nat.find hex, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩⟩
  · intro x hx
    rcases hform n x (by simp) with rfl | ⟨u, a, hu, rfl⟩
    · exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · have hta : t ^ a ∈ I := (Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem I hu).1 hx
      have hle := Nat.find_min' hex hta
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hle
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.2 ⟨u * t ^ c, by rw [pow_add]; ring⟩
  · exact (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem I).2 (Nat.find_spec hex)
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (t : R), IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {t} → ∀ I : Ideal R, I.IsPrincipal
